description: Hill (moist granular / capillary suction) contact model: nonlinear elasticity with moisture-induced suction forces. Available on 6.0/7.0/9.x; property set live-enumerated. SETUP REQUIREMENT (live): the model derives elasticity from body SURFACE properties - 'model clean' can fail with 'Surface property young_mod has not been assigned to a body' when balls lack young_mod (observed intermittently on 9.7: some cleans pass with young_mod/pois_ratio at the -1.0 sentinel and the check fires later). Set them via ball property with QUOTED names (ball property 'young_mod' 1e8 'pois_ratio' 0.3 - unquoted names are rejected). Even when clean errors, the contact is still created and props() reads back fine.

property_groups.name: Hill Group
property_groups.description: Parameters and state variables per the user guide; names, types and defaults are those live PFC3D reports for a freshly created contact.

properties.description: Moisture force; a positive value is tension, i.e. suction (state variable)
Moisture state: 0 = dry, 1 = dry and ruptured, 2 = wet. Set through the make_wet and make_dry methods (state variable)
Normal damping coefficient [kg·m^(-1/4)·s^(-1)], derived from damp_con (state variable)
Normal stiffness coefficient [N·m^(-3/2)], derived from the bodies' moduli and radii (state variable)
Contact overlap; a positive value is overlap (state variable)
Poisson's ratio of the body. A surface property of the ball or clump, not set on the contact
Shear damping coefficient [kg·m^(-1/4)·s^(-1)], derived from damp_con (state variable)
Shear stiffness coefficient [N·m^(-3/2)], derived from the bodies' moduli and radii (state variable)
Surface-interaction force (-F_n^s, F_ss, F_st); a positive F_n^s is tension (state variable)
Young's modulus of the body. A surface property of the ball or clump, not set on the contact

notes: Property set live-verified identical on PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.7. The intermittent 'model clean' surface-property error occurs on all three versions; the contact is still created and props() reads back fine.

Methods (user guide): 'make_wet gap <f>' adds moisture if the contact gap is at most the moisture gap (mois_state becomes 2); 'make_dry' removes it (mois_state becomes 0). The moisture force updates on the next cycle.
source: Itasca UDM library: Potyondy (2019), Hill Contact Model [version 4], ICG7795-L (https://itasca-software.s3.amazonaws.com/udm-library/HillContactModelAug29_2019.pdf); property set live-enumerated on PFC3D 6.00/7.00/9.7
